column3: “Pursued closely” is rendered “overtook,” and “struck down” as “killed.”
“They found him” is rendered “hit him,” and “he was in severe pain” as “he was badly wounded.” The meaning of the verb is uncertain.
“Deal wantonly with me” is rendered “make sport of me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with those” renders the Hebrew “and who.”
“Armor” is rendered “weapons,” and NASB supplies “them” and “good” in “carry the good news.”
“House of Ashtaroth” is rendered “temple of Ashtaroth,” and “armor” as “weapons.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB links the verse to verse 12.
“Every man of strength” is rendered “all the valiant men.”
